selected_capture: latest WARC-Date <= cutoff; equal dates choose lexicographically smallest Record-ID
record_scope: only supplied archive, GET response/revisit; no transfer/content compression in this fixture
revisit_resolution: explicit WARC-Refers-To is authoritative and must resolve; do not silently fallback to digest when explicit reference is bad; absent Refers-To may resolve by digest among response payloads with date<=cutoff; equal bytes may have multiple provenance supports
payload_check: verify actual bytes using sha1 base32 digest; current revisit HTTP headers retain current capture identity
url_identity: lowercase scheme/host, remove default port and fragment, resolve dot segments; preserve percent-encoded slash and exact query order
fragment_target: id attribute or a[name]; report missing target after redirects
redirect: resolve Location against redirect original URL; if Location has no fragment preserve incoming fragment; detect cycle by canonical URL
export: stable path keyed by canonical URL, content may differ with cutoff; no live original-site references in rendered navigation/resources
payload_rewrite: original digest covers original bytes, exported digest covers rewritten bytes
resource_failures: local diagnostic placeholder or explicit unresolved local link; never silently use older capture
serve: bind 127.0.0.1 with a selectable port; no remote fetching
